source_snapshot.items: US.4_USB BMC to BF4 USB Hub functional
source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC-to-BF4 USB hub link and show all downstream devices.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_USB_BMC_to_BF4; 30 attended/30 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic filtered host lsusb plus operator observation, without BF4 instance or child identity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; identified hub-only versus all-downstream conflict and required BF4-bound topology/manifest evidence.

old_problem: Procedure requires the intended BF4 hub and every downstream function, but Criteria grants PASS for any detected hub. The acronym does not identify a unique board, so another accelerator/DPU or generic root hub could also be misattributed.
disposition_reason: The BF4 instance and its management route must be bound, and the contradictory acceptance scopes can produce different verdicts. ED-19 prohibits silently discarding downstream coverage. Read-only evidence for both scopes is feasible, but authoritative PASS/FAIL remains unavailable until the project defines BF4 and resolves hub-only versus child-complete acceptance.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2172, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2173 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00060-V002 / 0986485b29287ced was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Define BF4 and bind serial/PN/slot/BDF or vendor management identity plus population/N/A policy.
Resolve exact BF4 hub-only versus hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance; until then collect both without a verdict.
Map BMC controller/root-port/board/connectors/cable to the BF4 hub and authoritative enumeration endpoint.
Freeze exact hub and every per-port child identity/speed, excluding other accelerator/DPU and generic hubs.
Operator verifies/photographs the physical route; capture unfiltered descriptors and reset/flap/management evidence without state change.
No query, physical manipulation, USB/BF4 state change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: BF4-identity-bound BMC USB hub and downstream topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Prove the dedicated BMC-to-intended-BF4 USB route, exact hub and full downstream management functions while preserving both conflicting acceptance scopes.
required_package: Definition and stable identity/population of the target BF4
Acceptance ruling for exact hub only versus hub plus all downstream devices
BMC-to-BF4 route and authoritative enumeration surface
Frozen hub/per-port child identity and speed manifest
Operator path photos, error limits, N/A policy and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Operator proves the BF4 identity and route. On the authoritative surface collect complete unfiltered USB tree, exact hub/child descriptors, speeds and reset/error history; compare hub and each child separately, report both scopes and leave BF4/USB state unchanged.
test_case.expected_result: The exact BF4 route/hub is proven, other hubs are excluded, every child is classified and BMC/BF4 management remains stable; final PASS awaits the scope ruling.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while BF4 identity or source scopes are unresolved. Apply the future ruling to the exact hub and, if Procedure coverage is retained, every child. Wrong BF4/route, missing required child or health limit breach is FAIL under the applicable scope; missing ruling is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED for verdict until BF4 identity, acceptance, topology and manifest are signed.
Read-only collection only; operator confirms physical route without replug.
No reset, deauthorize, rebind, firmware/power action or retry.
Stop on identity ambiguity, management degradation, reset storm, downgrade or flapping.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, BF4 definition/identity and conflict disposition
BF4 population plus BMC-to-BF4 route photos/map
Authoritative full USB tree and exact hub/child descriptors/speeds
BF4-specific manifest comparison with missing/unexpected/moved/downgraded items
Separate hub-only/all-downstream outcomes, recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on instability. Leave the BF4 management path unchanged and use only approved recovery; do not replug, reset, rebind, update firmware, power-cycle or retry to alter the result.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure requires all BF4 downstream devices while Criteria declares PASS from hub detection alone.

blocked.reason: Both evidence scopes are collectable, but final acceptance remains Engineering Decision Pending.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BF4 definition/identity/population, acceptance ruling, BMC-to-BF4 route/enumeration owner, hub/child oracle, N/A/error policy and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION AND SOURCE CONFLICT PENDING; READ-ONLY EVIDENCE PLAN DEFINED; NO QUERY, PHYSICAL/USB/BF4 STATE CHANGE, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Test-spec owner, BF4/platform USB architecture owner and hardware operator
pending.unlock_condition: Define/bind BF4, approve hub-only or hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance and freeze topology/manifest, then re-review.

external_authorities.application: Preserves source coverage and target identity and prohibits silent scope reduction or stateful retry.

project_authority: Test-spec owner resolves acceptance; BF4/platform owner defines target/topology/manifest; operator supplies physical proof; engineer owns verdict.
